known_limitations: I2N accuracy is 0.0 for all conditions — the model does not learn to map synthetic face images to identity aliases with the current image population (augmented variants of 2-5 generated faces per identity).
M mediated path (Image→Identity→Fact) cannot compose because I2N is not learned.
D direct path (Image→Fact) is successfully learned at DV_syn=0.80.
This is a synthetic-image-quality limitation, not a code/training bug.
rationale: D calibration is successful. M calibration shows that synthetic face images lack sufficient discriminability for I2N learning. Proceeding with canonical training using these hyperparameters. The canonical run will document this as a known limitation. Route establishment may fail on R1 (I2N) and R3 (DV_M), which is scientifically informative: it demonstrates that the mediated route cannot be established with current synthetic image quality.
